en.title: Kit Harington Found Solace in Harry Potter Audiobooks During Sobriety Journey
en.summary: The actor, set to join the upcoming HBO 'Harry Potter' series, reveals how the wizarding world's audiobooks became a crucial companion during his sobriety journey. Harington opens up about his personal struggles and how familiar tales provided comfort.
en.body:
The wizarding world of **Harry Potter** has a way of enchanting fans, and it appears that magic extended beyond the screen and pages to help actor **Kit Harington** navigate a significant personal challenge. Best known for his stoic portrayal of **Jon Snow** in HBO's monumental series **Game of Thrones**, Harington is now set to step into the shoes of the flamboyant Gilderoy Lockhart in HBO's forthcoming **Harry Potter** television series. However, before donning the robes of the charming but vain Defense Against the Dark Arts teacher, the actor found an unexpected source of strength in the very franchise he's joining.

Harington recently shared on the *Happy Sad Confused* podcast that the **Harry Potter** audiobooks played a vital role in his journey toward sobriety. He explained that his mind often races, making sleep a difficult endeavor, a struggle that intensified after he decided to stop drinking alcohol. The familiar narrative of a young wizard battling dark forces became a grounding presence, a consistent companion that helped quiet his busy thoughts during the challenging nights. This personal connection to the **Harry Potter** universe deepens as he prepares to embody a character from its storied past.

## A Witch's Brew of Comfort

The actor's upcoming role as Gilderoy Lockhart in the HBO **Harry Potter** series marks a significant return to the fantasy genre for **Kit Harington**. He admitted to being "a bit of a nerd" for the wizarding world, making the decision to join the project a simple "Yes, please!" He highlighted his comfort with the idea of reprising roles that require a certain gravitas, but his embrace of the eccentric Lockhart suggests a willingness to explore different facets of his acting persona. The casting itself has generated considerable excitement among fans eager to see how **Harington** will interpret the character, originally brought to life by **Kenneth Branagh** in the film adaptations.

> "My brain is incredibly busy, especially at night, and I’ve always found going to bed very difficult like and my brain doesn’t turn off. When I got sober that got especially bad. So I started listening to Harry Potter audio books, and now they’re the thing I listen to every night." — **Kit Harington**

## Potterheads and Personal Journeys

For fans of **Kit Harington**, this revelation offers a more intimate glimpse into the man behind the iconic characters. It underscores the universal nature of personal struggles and the diverse ways individuals find coping mechanisms. The **Harry Potter** franchise, with its themes of friendship, courage, and overcoming adversity, has resonated with millions globally. For **Harington**, it became a personal sanctuary, a reminder that even in difficult times, stories can provide solace and a path forward. The upcoming series, slated for a 2027 release, now carries an added layer of significance for those who have followed his career and his candidness about his recovery.

## What's Next

As production gears up for the **Harry Potter** series, fans will be keenly watching **Kit Harington**'s portrayal of Gilderoy Lockhart. While a specific release date for his episodes has not yet been announced, the series is expected to debut in 2027, offering a new generation a fresh immersion into J.K. Rowling's beloved universe.
